module: Utility module (loaded by require) that builds the performance snapshot sent by the performanceSpatial tracker: FPS (instantaneous, average, min, p99), frame time, CPU/GPU, FPS cap cause, camera position and settings, world state (time scale, vehicle count, split screen, traffic) and, optionally, the time breakdown by frame phase and render statistics. Values are rounded.
notes: framePhases is only added if options.renderTimingTrackingEnabled; renderStats only if options.sceneComplexityTrackingEnabled.
The phases come from Engine.Debug.getLastPerformanceMetrics; gpuWaitMs falls back to the FramePresent phase if absent.
Camera position rounded to 0.1 m, angles to 0.1 degree.

capture.desc: Returns an event table: level, fpsInstant, fpsAvg, fpsMin, fpsP99, frameMs, cpuMs, gpuMs, gpuWaitMs, limitedBy, activeGpu, position, camera, textureStreaming, worldReadyState, simTimeScale, vehicleCount, splitScreenPlayers, trafficCount, and optionally framePhases and renderStats.

activeGpu.desc: Description of the active GPU, copied as is.
